name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Aura 2026 UI Transformation: Floating Capsule Pill Dock with spring morph animations and dynamic theme lighting.
Atmospheric Ambient Mesh Glow: Soft chromatic back-illumination adapting dynamically to selected theme palette.
Signature Hero Typography: Sleek bold header 'Explore and download' with gradient accent text.
Card Architecture Overhaul: Frosted squircle bento cards with upper glass bevel highlight and corner aura.
Fluid Spring Physics: GPU-composited responsive micro-interactions across pills, chips, and buttons.
